Q.name: Quartermaster Dov Harrow
lines: Hold's a mess, I know where everything is. Mostly.
Bring me salvage, I'll bring you creds. Counter's not open yet, though.
Don't lean on the reactor housing. She bites.

T.name: Signals Tech Ines Ruhl
lines: Anything you pull out of the dark comes back scrambled. I unscramble it.
Decoder bank's still warming up. Give me time.
If a piece of gear starts humming at you, bring it straight to me. Don't listen to it.

M.name: Medic Oskar Venn
lines: Sit. Bleed quietly. I'll get to you.
I lost my licence on Thessaly. I didn't lose my hands.
Come back in one piece. Fewer pieces, more paperwork.
revive_lines: Easy. Easy. You were dead for a bit. Don't make a habit of it.
The Cradle put you back together. Mostly the right way round.
Welcome back. That's another one I'm not filing paperwork for.

F.name: Kesh, a fence
lines: Passenger. Strictly passenger. Don't ask what's in the crates.
Sealed salvage, operative. Could be junk. Could be a fortune. That's the fun.
I'll have stock once we hit a port with fewer customs officers.

P.name: Pilot Mara Quill
lines: She flies. Don't ask me how. Don't ask her either.
Pick a heading on the nav console and I'll get us there. Probably in one piece.
Third coolant leak this week. That's a record. A good one.
